title: Tokyo NECRO

routes.title: 義城蜜魅ルート
routes.notes: Recommended first route in the primary Japanese ordering source. Route condition is エチカ=上/屋上 (screen-right in source 1), then 早雲=イリア (screen-left in source 1), producing 蜜魅END.

routes.title: 阿蘇霧里ルート
routes.notes: Recommended second route. Route condition is エチカ=下/地下 (screen-left in source 1), then 早雲=ミルグラム (screen-right in source 1), producing 霧里END.

routes.title: コン・スールート
routes.notes: Recommended third route. Route condition is エチカ=上/屋上 (screen-right in source 1), then 早雲=ミルグラム (screen-right in source 1), producing コン・スーEND.

routes.title: 宝形イリアルート
routes.notes: Recommended fourth heroine route. Route condition is エチカ=下/地下 (screen-left in source 1), then 早雲=イリア (screen-left in source 1), producing イリアEND. Multiple Japanese sources recommend leaving Iria until last among the four heroine routes because it connects most naturally into the final route.

routes.title: TRUE END
routes.notes: Unlocks only after all four heroine endings. Source 1 gives the complete final-route interaction: from the title screen choose SEARCH, select 検索 twelve times, then choose the center option, leading to TRUE END. Source 2 independently confirms that clearing all four heroine routes adds the final route item to the title screen, but does not spell out the twelve-search interaction.

sources.title: Tokyo NECRO 凍京NECRO＜トウキョウ・ネクロ＞ 攻略 - LastCharles
sources.notes: Primary complete Japanese walkthrough. Gives the three save positions, exact left/right route branches for all four heroine endings, and the complete post-clear TRUE END sequence (title-screen SEARCH, 検索 x12, center choice). Its published route order is optimized around save reuse rather than story order.

sources.title: 凍京NECRO（トウキョウネクロ）の感想や攻略順!百合ゲー？
sources.notes: Second independent Japanese route guide. The author states they completed all routes, lists all four route combinations using エチカ 上/下 and 早雲 イリア/ミルグラム, confirms all four clears unlock the last route from the title screen, and recommends 義城蜜魅 → 阿蘇霧里 → コン・スー → 宝形イリア. It does not document save points or the internal SEARCH x12 steps, so those fields are explicitly marked 第二ガイドに記載なし where applicable.

sources.title: 凍京NECRO の感想 - スピカの忘れ物
sources.notes: Supplementary Japanese source for route-order corroboration. Recommends 霧里 → コン・スー → 蜜魅 → イリア → TRUE, agrees there is no enforced heroine route order, recommends Iria last, and confirms TRUE appears after all heroine clears.

sources.title: 伝統攻撃 凍京NECRO 感想
sources.notes: Supplementary Japanese structural source. Confirms exactly two binary choices determine the four routes, explicitly maps 左左=イリア, 右左=蜜魅, 左右=霧里, 右右=コン・スー, states there is no route-order restriction, and recommends Iria last for story flow.

sources.title: 凍京NECRO＜トウキョウ・ネクロ＞ 攻略 - 誠也の部屋
sources.notes: Additional known Japanese walkthrough identified by multiple external references. The page itself was not used for guide fields in this pass because its legacy encoding could not be reliably decoded through the available fetch path; no unverified text from it was copied into the guide.

disagreements: 1) There is no enforced order among the four heroine routes. Japanese recommendation sources differ on the preferred first three routes, but they consistently recommend leaving Iria until last before TRUE. This guide adopts source 2's explicit full recommendation: 蜜魅 → 霧里 → コン・スー → イリア → TRUE. 2) Source 1 numbers its reusable saves for its own completion order (Iria → Kiriri → Mitsumi → Con Su). Because this guide follows a different recommended order, the same three physical checkpoints are renumbered sequentially as セーブ1/2/3 while jpGuide1 preserves source 1's original save labels verbatim. 3) Source 2 documents all four branch combinations and the final-route unlock but does not document save locations or the TRUE route's twelve individual 検索 interactions. Those omissions are represented honestly with （第二ガイドに記載なし） rather than inferred or copied from source 1. 4) The first decision is described semantically as 上/下 by source 2 and as right=屋上 / left=地下 by source 1; supplemental Japanese source 4 independently confirms the screen-direction matrix. The second decision is similarly right=ミルグラム / left=イリア.
